A '''[[Cloning/Legends|clone]]''' was stationed in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised himself as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] and infiltrated the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center to uncover a plot to abduct [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this clone was working in the detention facility's cremation center along with three other clones.<ref name="Deception" />

After the undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] along with prisoners [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] started a prison riot in the mess hall, they managed to evade the prison [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|guards]] and used the morgue to escape, hiding inside caskets which were sent to the cremation center. After the caskets arrived, the [[Unidentified clone (cremation center)|clones]] detected vital signs inside the caskets and started checking them. The prisoners then jumped out and began to attack them. This clone was tackled by Obi-Wan Kenobi, who could not bring himself to kill him, which resulted in the clone calling in for more reinforcements. Cad Bane then noticed the incident and shot the clone, scolding Obi-Wan for not killing him.<ref name="Deception" />
